authority: Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science 9618 syllabus, 2027-2029, Version 2

records.resolution: Names and distinguishes kibi/kilo, mebi/mega, gibi/giga and tebi/tera in visible CORE teaching, practice, assessment and a required visual.
Maps binary, denary, hexadecimal, BCD, one's complement and two's complement across L002, L003, L005 and L006 with reviewed evidence.
Adds explicit integer conversion teaching and evidence for the required bases and representations.
Provides visible addition and subtraction instruction for positive and negative fixed-width binary integers and replaces L005-Q5 with a direct subtraction assessment.
Defines overflow by representable range and fixed width, with counterexamples preventing carry-bit and leading-one misconceptions.
Teaches and assesses practical BCD and hexadecimal applications instead of treating conversion alone as sufficient evidence.
Covers ASCII, extended ASCII, Unicode, internal binary codes and the explicit no-memorisation boundary.
Uses the official drawing object, property and drawing list vocabulary and requires an application-specific bitmap/vector justification.
